title: Model falsifier bench

title: Continuum consistency probes

title: Fifteen open-problem probes

title: Framework comparison mosaic

title: Freed ID claim contracts

title: Allocation and appeal models

title: Operational wellbeing record
acceptance: Record human-controlled workload, failure burden and resource limits as operational metadata, with no subjective wellbeing inference.

title: Family main skills

title: Shared deterministic runners

title: Five advisory hooks

title: Workflow v20 and full roster
acceptance: Publish current limits and all numbered assignments from Avelin v707-v6 through Eiren v725-v8, with an interstitial remaster and one terminal successor.

title: D-first platform readiness

title: Local/cloud Nexus bridge

title: Evidence integrity and privacy

title: Reproducible closeout and baton
